read.en: Bloom Energy fell 4.9% on Nov 13 to $191.99, trading $183.89–205.92. It is below the 5-day ($196.5), 10-day ($193.4), 30-day ($225.3), 100-day ($235.8) and 200-day ($223.5); the 5 and 200-day are rising. MACD has been above its signal since Nov 12, below zero, histogram still slightly positive; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 4 ($217.85), and RSI is 43.5.
read.zh: Bloom Energy 11月13日下跌 4.9%，收于 $191.99，盘中区间 $183.89–205.92。股价位于 5 日（$196.5）、10 日（$193.4）、30 日（$225.3）、100 日（$235.8）和 200 日均线（$223.5）下方；5 日和 200 日均线在上行。MACD 自 11月12日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图仍略为正值；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看空（$217.85），RSI 为 43.5。

read.en: The close lost the 10-day and the $193.4–199.8 support, now resistance; the $183.89 low dipped into the $183.9–189 band and recovered. Resistance is $193.4–196.5 (10 and 5-day), then $205.9–209.5 (Nov 11–13 highs and closes) and $217.9 (SAR, Nov 11 high). Support is $183.9–189, then $168.8–173.2 (Nov 6) and $156 (Nov 5 low). A close above $196.5 would target $202–209.5; below $183.9, $169–173.
